---
title: Diagram Cards
format: dashboard
_quarto:
  tests:
    dashboard:
      # A dot or mermaid diagram block is a card, as a Quarto 1 {dot} /
      # {mermaid} cell is: bare in a row it gets its own card, and alone in
      # a .card div it fills that card's body under the div's title.
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "div.bslib-card > div.card-body > pre.graphviz",
            "div.bslib-card > div.card-body > pre.mermaid",
            "div.bslib-card > div.card-header > div.card-title",
          ]
        - [
            "div.bslib-grid > pre",
            "div.card[title]",
          ]
---

## Row

```dot
digraph G { rankdir=LR; a -> b }
```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A --> B
```

## Row

::: {.card title="Flow card"}

```dot
digraph G { rankdir=LR; start -> middle -> finish }
```

:::

::: {.card title="Mermaid card"}

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  C --> D
```

:::
